I added a 0.25s sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`, which caps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the 5/s limit. I haven't run the tests, because they hit the real sandbox. The delay is a `CALL_DELAY_S` constant at the top of the file, so you can tune it.

The sleep also runs after the last call, which costs 0.25s but keeps the loop simple.

I also saved a note about the 5 req/s limit to EngramDB, so future sessions will know about it.
